player_prompt.intro:
Yu wok long solvim Sokoban puzzle. Yu stap player na yu mas pushim ol box i go long target.
        Taim yu stap klostu long box, yu ken pushim long move long same direkshin.
        Yu no ken pushim box i go insait long wall, na yu no ken pulim box.
        Long board, ol samting i kamap olsem: 
        - Player (yu) i kamap olsem 'P' 
        - Ol wall i kamap long '#' 
        - Ol box i makim 'X' 
        - Ol empty goal i soim long 'O'
        - Ol box long goal i kamap long '√'
        Yu ken tu usim [w] long go antap, [a] long go lef, [s] long go daun, na [d] long go rait.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Muvim yu givim i no folow format bilong stret. Usim [up], [down], [left], [right] o [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.wall_collision: Yu no inap go insait long banis!
invalid_move.invalid_position: Move i no korrekt - yu no ken move i go long dispela posishin.

outcome.win: Mi amamas long yu bin stretim tok bilong Sokoban!
outcome.turn_limit: Taim bilong wokim muv i pinis. Yu no bin solvim puzzle.
